patch.value: GH-817: machine-readable flag contracts need semantic invocation metadata and stdin capability

pm contracts command_flags currently exposes flag names without descriptions, value types, required/repeatable semantics, or accepts_stdin, forcing agents back to human help and hiding safe streaming paths for body-sized inputs.

command_flags entries expose descriptions value types required repeatable and accepts_stdin from one canonical declaration; body and description stdin support is documented consistently in help and contracts; CLI SDK MCP and generated schemas remain parity-checked; compact contract projections remain bounded and measured; installed-consumer acceptance proves agents can discover and use stdin without scraping help
Make machine contracts sufficient to invoke every declared flag safely
Agents select streaming and typed invocation paths without spending context on help prose or risking argv limits
Enriches the universal command contract for core and extension-provided flags
GH-817 demonstrates that the recommended discovery path cannot explain how to call its own flags
